messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT: KV eviction storm detected in prod-cluster-a (rope longscroll shards). Auto-pager opened to #incidents. Symptoms: sustained token latency spikes, >95% evictions, uptick in 5xx for text generation routes. Pager: maya (oncall). Link: https://internal.monitor/prod/alerts/2177654321

maya (oncall): seeing +800% eviction rate since ~21:03 UTC, tail latency up 3-5x on /v1/generate. Some customers reporting 503s. I'm on it.

jordan: adding traces - looks correlated with long-context calls (window_keepalive + NTK sampling enabled on a subset). YaRN backpressure pattern showing frequent prefix invalidations.

jordan: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-14T21:02:58Z rope-shard-07 kv_eviction=98.7% rt_p90=1240ms errors=7.8% model=longscroll-3
2026-03-14T21:03:05Z prefetcher: enqueue long context job size=64 ntk_enabled=true
2026-03-14T21:03:07Z yarn: slotmap_overflow=1
```

eva: hypothesis: continuous-batching + longscroll prefetch (NTK/YaRN sliding window) is causing the KV working set to blow up and thrash. Immediate mitigations we can attempt:
- disable longscroll prefetch flag for affected model group
- cap continuous-batching size and reduce batch window (reduce latency headroom)
- apply temporary eviction policy change (age-based) on KV store
- throttle NTK sampling for long contexts

samir: agreed. Runbook step sequence (safe order):
1) flip feature flag to disable prefetch for model group (server-side FF).
2) patch batch config: `batch.max_tokens=4096` -> `batch.max_tokens=2048`, `batch.max_concurrent=8`
3) set KV eviction policy to `age_based` and lower `max_entries` per-slot
4) watch metrics for 10m, if stable, gradually re-enable with smaller window

samir: run these with `ops-runbook` jobs. Commands: 
```bash
# disable ff
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" \
  https://featureflags.internal/api/v1/flags/disable \
  -d '{"flag":"longscroll-prefetch","target":"model_group:longscroll"}'

# patch batch config
kubectl -n inference patch cm batch-config --patch '{"data":{"max_concurrent":"8","max_tokens":"2048"}}'
# restart router (graceful)
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/router --selector=zone=prod-a
```

maya (oncall): starting step 1 (FF disable) now. Posting responses.

maya (oncall): `curl` returned 200. Flag disabled for model_group:longscroll. ops-runbook-bot triggered job: disable-prefetch-longscroll (job id 7832).

ops-runbook-bot: job disable-prefetch-longscroll started by maya (oncall). Step 1 complete.

maya (oncall): patching batch config to reduce concurrent batches. Applying now.

maya (oncall): `kubectl patch` applied, rollout restart started for router pods (3/3 restarting).
```
> kubectl get pods -l app=router -n inference
router-7f8x  Terminating
router-9c3b  Running
router-1a2d  Running
```

liam: quick Q — do we have customer impact scoreboard? which customers hit 5xx?

maya (oncall): initial query shows 3 customers with >2% error rate in last 10m: corp-alpha, shopforward, analytics-inc. Estimated affected requests ~12k over 8m window. I've DM'd SEs.

jordan: while restart is rolling, propose one more hotpatch: lower `rope.slotmap_limit` so long contexts don't reserve giant slotmaps. Suggested: `rope.slotmap_limit=32` (from 256).

eva: that should reduce per-request KV footprint immediately. We can apply via configmap and hot-reload on runtime (supports live reconfig).

samir: command to apply slotmap limit:
```bash
kubectl -n inference patch cm rope-config --patch '{"data":{"slotmap_limit":"32"}}'
curl -X POST http://inference-config-reloader.prod/reload -d '{"component":"rope"}'
```

maya (oncall): applied slotmap_limit patch + triggered reload. Re-loader returned 202.

ops-runbook-bot: job disable-prefetch-longscroll completed. job id 7832.

maya (oncall): metrics update (21:12 UTC): eviction rate down from 98% -> 7% across affected shards, p90 latency from 1240ms -> 280ms, error rate down to 0.9%. Visible improvement across regions.

jordan: nice. Can we confirm NTK sampling throttled? We should flip sampler rate to 0.1 for long contexts before enabling prefetch again.

eva: noted. I'll create follow-up task to instrument per-tenant sampling and add guardrails.

liam: customer comms: SEs sent interim note to corp-alpha with ETA for full resolution. No data loss, just elevated error/latency.

maya (oncall): handing off to liam for post-incident tracking and to eva for follow-up config fixes. I'll go offline in 30m. Full timeline/commands below for the postmortem.

maya (oncall): timeline + commands (for PM):
- 21:03 alert fired (kv evictions spike)
- 21:04 identified longscroll prefetch + continuous-batch interaction (NTK sampling)
- 21:05 disabled feature flag `longscroll-prefetch` (curl -> 200)
- 21:07 patched batch config to cap concurrent batches to 8 and max_tokens to 2048
- 21:08 restarted routers (graceful)
- 21:09 applied `rope.slotmap_limit=32` and hot-reloaded rope config
- 21:12 metrics returned to healthy ranges

samir: we'll own an immediate hotfix PR to add a circuit-breaker: if kv_eviction > 20% for >30s, auto-throttle prefetch and reduce batch window. Assign to: eva (owner), samir (review), maya (verifier).

liam: scheduling incident postmortem 1h from now in #postmortems. Please add logs, traces, and list of affected customers.

eva: quick note — we should add synthetic tests for long-context prefetch to CI to catch working-set blowups. Filed ticket INF-2248.

maya (oncall): leaving notes: if you need anything immediate ping me. handing to liam. :thumbsup:

liam: taking over. I'll update JIRA, coordinate SE comms, and track the hotfix PR. Thanks team. :eyes:
